title: Module Review Quiz: Basic Concepts (CPP_101 to CPP_110)

slides.title: Module 1 Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers foundational C++ topics from CPP_101 to CPP_110: Basic Syntax, Variables, Operators, Control Flow, Loops, Functions, Arrays, Pointers, and Constants.

slides.title: Header Inclusion (CPP_101)
slides.prompt: Fill in the standard library required for basic input and output operations.

slides.title: Data Types & Variables (CPP_102)
slides.prompt: Which primitive data type is most appropriate for high-precision floating-point numbers?

slides.title: Arithmetic Operators (CPP_103)
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator used to calculate the remainder of an integer division.

slides.title: Control Flow - Switch Statement (CPP_104)
slides.prompt: What happens if you omit the 'break' statement in a switch case?
options: Execution falls through to the next case
slides.correctAnswer: Execution falls through to the next case

slides.title: Loops & Iteration (CPP_105)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword for a loop structure that guarantees executing the block at least once.

slides.title: Functions & Scope (CPP_107)
slides.prompt: Which return type should be used for a function that does NOT return any value?

slides.title: Arrays & Strings (CPP_108)
slides.prompt: Fill in the index used to access the very first element of an array in C++.

slides.title: Pointers & Memory (CPP_109)
slides.prompt: Which symbol is used as the 'address-of' operator to retrieve the memory address of a variable?

slides.title: Constants (CPP_110)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to declare a variable whose value cannot be modified after initialization.

slides.title: Case Sensitivity (CPP_101)
slides.prompt: Is C++ a case-sensitive programming language?

slides.title: Pass by Reference (CPP_107)
slides.prompt: Fill in the character used in the parameter list to pass a variable by reference.

slides.title: Dereference Operator (CPP_109)
slides.prompt: Which operator is used to dereference a pointer and access the value at its memory address?
